name: blueprint/browser-session-log
description: Browsing sessions with evidence: one receipt per step (url, action, finding), a session summary, and the records feed the weekly review
ingredients: the weekly review reads the session
recipe: record each step as it happens (url, action, finding) -> keep evidence per finding -> summarize the session -> the records feed the weekly review
pitfalls: record steps before the page changes - evidence evaporates
findings carry actual vs expected (dogfood discipline)
the session receipt is the memory the conversation will not keep
